postmortems.name: ABNB
postmortems.what_happened: ABNB (long against XLY, consumer discretionary ETF) was stopped on its third session, down 7.0% at 3:45 PM ET. The setup was a post-earnings gap that held; instead ABNB gave the gap back, from 189.99 at entry to about 181.5, below the signal day's midpoint (188.28), while XLY rose about 3%. One report (StockStory, 11-08) put the selling on a next-quarter guide below estimates despite faster bookings growth; other reports conflict and no fresh ABNB news on 11-10 or 11-11 was found. The gap failing to hold is the reason itself failing.
postmortems.lesson: A gap-held long needs the next-quarter guide to be clean, not just the quarter; when reports disagree on the guide, check consensus against it before taking the gap.
